text: Hello, hello! Welcome to Flop Island!
Big news: the Great Flop Festival is coming! Music, cake and fireworks!
First, let me show you around.
You're a natural! Everyone will love you here.
Grr... festivals are too NOISY.
Did you hear a grumble? Never mind! Dot the Postie needs a hand.
Oh good, you came!
The festival invitations got mixed up with the parcels.
Can you help me deliver them?
Every house got its parcel. Thank you!
But someone left a note on my door. It says: NO PARTIES! From, the Grumble Gang.
Better tell Officer Bun!
Officer Bun here. Big trouble!
Sneaky Sam took the festival cake!
He's in the Grumble Gang. Let's catch him!
Okay, okay! Boss Grumble told me to take it!
Boss Grumble? The big grumpy one? Hmm.
The cake is safe now. Coco needs help with the festival food!
Hi! I'm making juice for the festival.
But the Grumble Gang drank it all! Can you get me coconuts?
Mamma mia! A hot pizza for the festival helpers!
Take it while it's hot. Hurry!
Pizza and juice! The festival will be yummy.
Farmer Fern called. Something about sheep! Take the bus to Sunny Farm.
Howdy! The festival needs carrot cake.
Pull up my carrots and toss them in the cart.
Oh no! The Grumble Gang opened my sheep pen!
Can you bring all 3 sheep back home?
My sheep are safe and sound!
Foreman Rex is building the festival stage. Hop on the bus to the Construction Site!
We're building the festival stage!
The Gang knocked our tower down. Help me build it again!
Look at that! Strong and tall.
Hey... do you smell smoke? It is coming from town!
Captain Splash here! The Gang set off fireworks, and now the roofs are on fire!
Grab a bucket, fill it with water and splash those flames!
Hooray, all the fires are out! You are a hero!
Grr! Those fireworks were for LATER!
Guide Gil needs glowing crystals for the festival lanterns. Off to the mountain!
Hello, explorer! The festival lanterns need crystals.
First, race up Mount Wobble so you know the way!
Now find the treasure in the Crystal Cave.
It is full of shiny crystals!
So many crystals! The lanterns will glow.
Lifeguard Lu called. The beach needs you!
Help! The Grumble Gang popped all the swim rings!
Three swimmers are too tired to swim back. Please bring them to the beach!
Everyone is safe. Thank you!
Now it is time for the festival games! Ace is waiting at the Race Track.
Welcome to the festival games!
First up: one lap of the Race Track. Ready, set...
Next game: the Wobble Run!
Hop over everything and reach the finish!
You won the games! The festival is ready!
NOT so fast! Come to the stadium... if you dare!
Oh my! Boss Grumble wants a brawl. Go to the stadium!
So YOU are the one helping with this silly festival!
I do not like noisy parties. Hmph!
Beat me and my gang in a brawl, and you can have your party.
You beat me fair and square.
The truth is... nobody ever invited me to a party.
Then you are invited, Boss Grumble! Everyone is!
Really? Then... let us PARTY!
Welcome to the Great Flop Festival!
Hmph. Go away, I am busy grumbling.
Festivals are too loud. And too bouncy.
What are YOU looking at?
Grr. Nobody tells me anything.
My gang is the best gang. Hmph!
Best. Festival. EVER!
Want to see my party dance? Wobble wobble!
I am not grumpy any more. Well... only a little.
Thanks for inviting me, friend!
Here, take my old cap. I do not need to be grumpy any more!
Ready to brawl me and my gang? Throw us all off the Spin Cake... if you can!
The Grumble Gang is beaten. Time for the Great Flop Festival!
Do not give up! Punch him until he is dizzy, then grab him and throw him off.
Welcome to Flop Island! Let me show you around: pop into the Hat Shop, bounce on a trampoline, then come back and say hi.
Golden ducks are hiding all over the island. Can you find 3 more? I'll point you to the closest one.
Parcels are piling up! Take the Parcel Delivery job at my Job Board, then carry 3 parcels to the glowing houses.
I need coconuts for my juice! Punch the palm trees to knock them down, then drop 5 into my basket.
Sneaky Sam swiped the town cake! Catch him (a few punches slow him down), grab him and drop him in the jail cell by my station.
A hot pizza needs delivering! Grab the box from my counter and get it to the glowing house before it gets cold.
My carrots are ready! Grab them to pull them out of the ground, then toss 6 into the cart.
Oh no, my sheep got out of their pen! Push them or carry them, and get all 3 back inside.
We need a tower here! Carry 4 grey building blocks onto the yellow build pad.
Hop in the yellow race car (or any car), cross the start line and drive through all 8 gates. One lap in 75 seconds!
Race to the top of Mount Wobble and touch the flag at the summit, all within 2 minutes. Follow the winding trail!
There's treasure hidden in the Crystal Cave! The entrance is on the mountain's west side. Find the chest at the very back.
Can you beat the Wobble Run? Hop from the pink start pad across every obstacle to the finish island in 60 seconds!
Three swimmers are too tired to swim back! Swim out, grab each one and carry them to the beach.
Think you're tough? Win a Brawl Party: head into the stadium and be the champion. Online brawls with friends count too!
Grab a bucket and fill it at the tap (or in the sea). Then stand near a fire and PUNCH to splash it. Put out all 3!
Thanks for all your help! You're a real Flop Island hero.
I might need help later. Come back after you've helped some other islanders!

Welcome to the Job Center! Tap a job to hear all about it.
Carry parcels from the depot counter to the glowing houses.
Punch palm trees to knock coconuts down. Drop them in the juice basket.
Pick up the bags by the houses. Toss them in the dumpster or the garbage truck.
Drive the taxi. Pick up passengers and take them where they want to go.
A robber is loose! Catch them (a few punches help), grab them and drop them in jail.
Rush hot pizzas from the counter to the glowing houses.
Drive the ice cream van to hungry islanders. Stop next to them to serve.
Pull up carrots and toss them in the cart.
The sheep got out! Push or carry them back into the pen.
Carry grey building blocks onto the yellow build pad.
Roofs are on fire! Fill a bucket at the tap (or the sea) and PUNCH to splash. The fire truck sprays too!
Find glowing gems in the Crystal Cave and drop them in the mine cart.
Swimmers are tired! Swim out, grab them and carry them to the beach.
Drive one lap through all 8 gates. The faster you are, the more you earn!
Run the Wobble Run from the pink pad to the finish. Quick feet earn more!
Welcome to the Museum! Treasures are buried all over Flop Island. Take this map, dig up the treasure and bring it here for my museum.
More treasure is buried out there! Take this map, dig up the treasure and bring it here for my museum.
Every single treasure is in the museum! You are the best treasure hunter on Flop Island.
On the sandy beach behind the Arcade, between three palm trees.
A crown for a mermaid queen!
In the palm grove next to the Coconut Juice stand.
The very first golden duck!
On the beach right next to the town pier.
How did they get the ship inside?
Up the hill, at the foot of the Lighthouse.
It always points to treasure!
On Sunny Farm, right next to the scarecrow.
A real dinosaur bone. Roar!
On Sunny Farm, by the tall windmill.
Wind it up and it still walks!
Beside the pond under the Waterfall.
The biggest pearl in the whole sea!
In the sand at the Beach Resort, near the lifeguard tower.
Money from a thousand years ago!
Inside the Construction Site fence, near the big crane.
It fell from space. Still a bit warm!
In the grass in the middle of the Race Track.
Vikings drank juice from this. Probably.
Deep inside the Crystal Cave on the mountain.
Sparkly and cuddly at the same time!
At the very top of Mount Wobble, next to the flag.
A map of the stars. Wow!
Catch me some fish and I'll buy them! Bring them in your arms. Bigger fish and rarer fish pay more coins.
Fishing rods are free! Take one, walk to the water and cast your line.
Hide anywhere on Museum Isle for 60 seconds. Three seekers count to 10, then come looking. If one of them spots you up close, you are found!
Trash is raining into the yard next door! Grab it and feed it to the hungry bins: throw it in, or carry it close. You have 60 seconds.
Make your own playground! Spawn balls, crates, ramps, trampolines and cones in front of you, anywhere you like.
Beds, sofas, slides and more! But first you need a house to put them in. Look for the FOR SALE signs round the park.
Welcome to the Furniture Shop! Pick something cozy for your home.
Welcome to the Pet Shop! A pet follows you everywhere and fetches balls you throw.
One snug room and a porch for rocking. A perfect first home!
A pink cottage with a living room, a bedroom and a kitchen.
Two whole floors, a big staircase and a balcony. Fit for royalty!
A sunny villa with a big veranda and four rooms.
Welcome to the Hat Shop! Pick a hat you like.
Welcome to Fluff and Stuff! Comfy clothes for fluffy friends.
Welcome to the Car Shop! Win special vehicles with jobs and the story, or buy them here.
